summary: E2E (UI + API) test of the CloudIVR 'messages' flows as Alice in preview (WEB_CLOUDIVR_DRY_RUN=true). PASSED: Quick IVR with Script/template (template pick, auto-fill, transfer on key 1) -> 'Preview mode: 1 call(s) validated' + shown in Recent calls; Quick IVR with Audio library + '+ New audio' (upload /tmp/beep.mp3) -> saved and auto-selected with a preview player; menu mode (key1 forward + key2 message) with a clear validation error when the forward number is missing; scheduled Quick IVR (UTC and America/New_York browser tz: picked 13:54 EDT stored as 17:54Z, list shows 01:54 PM, timezone correct) + cancel; bulk campaign 'now' (picker audio + voicemail drop + 3 pasted leads + menu mode + concurrency 3 + cost estimate) saved, detail page OK; Cancel with confirm dialog -> cancelled + reason; repeat (daily) without schedule + Stop repeating (API); number IVR tab key action 'message' with text + audio picker + '+ New audio' saved and persisted (then removed); Text Triggers (Text-to-Call message) save + 'Try it'; Inbox SMS reply (seeded TEST inbound SMS) to a Canada number -> status preview, $0 charge. BLOCKED / FAILED: (1) scheduled bulk campaigns can't be created in preview at all ('Scheduling is turned off in preview mode — calls would be dialed for real.'), so the scheduled / repeating-next-run / auto-start-at-time flows CAN'T be tested here; (2) 'Start calling' in preview does nothing: the campaign stays 'created' and all leads stay 'pending' forever, so there's no way to check progress / results / per-lead outcomes; (3) the Add audio dialog layout is broken (giant oval tabs, empty space); (4) US->US SMS reply is blocked by 10DLC, and the message gives no next step.

critical.issue: In preview, any campaign with a Schedule is rejected with 400 dry_run in calls.js runPlan() line 66. The once-a-minute launcher in js/_index.js (~line 4580) also returns early when SKIP_WEBHOOK_SYNC=true. So the 'Schedule (optional)' picker, the 'scheduled' status, auto-start at the picked time, the repeat 'Next run' link (campaign-next-run-link) and run 2+ can never be tested end to end in preview. Quick IVR scheduling IS simulated in preview (status 'preview', then 'completed'), so the two features behave differently.

In preview, Start returns 202 'Preview mode: the campaign is saved but no numbers were dialed.' and changes nothing. The status stays 'created', progress stays 0%, every lead stays 'pending', and Start calling can be pressed again and again. No simulated run exists, so Live, results, per-lead outcomes, voicemail-drop counts, the CSV report and the repeat next-run creation (bulk-call-service nextRun is created only after a run completes) can't be verified.

minor.issue: A second reply overwrites meta.reply, so only the last reply is kept. The UI allows only one reply per inbox item, but the API accepts more than one.

Uploaded audio saves duration 0. audioUrl is stored with an absolute host from an old pod alias (c4ea8f4e-...preview.emergentagent.com). It works now because that alias routes to this pod, but the URL breaks if the host changes.

Preview-scheduled quick calls are flipped to 'completed' when the list is read (outbound.js line 312). They then show as 'completed' even though nothing ran, and no Recent-calls/history row is created.

ui_bugs.component: AudioAddDialog (AudioAdd.js), probably also the CallerIdPick.js dialog
ui_bugs.issue: The 'Add audio' dialog renders the 'Upload a recording' / 'Make one from text' tabs as huge ~130x190px ovals, with ~150px of empty space above them and a lot of empty space under the Upload card. Root cause: DialogContent has className 'civr ...', and '.civr { min-height: 100vh }' (cloudivr.css line ~15) forces the grid dialog to full height, which stretches its rows. Fix: add '!min-h-0' (or 'min-h-0 h-auto content-start') to the DialogContent className in AudioAdd.js and CallerIdPick.js.

In preview the Schedule picker is fully enabled. The user fills in the whole campaign and only learns on Save that scheduling is off. Also, the AI voice for a written script is created first (scriptAudio() runs before the API rejects the schedule), which leaves an orphan audio in the library. Either show a preview note or disable the picker in dry-run, and validate before generating TTS.

integration_issues.flow: SMS reply from Inbox to a US number
integration_issues.issue: The reply is blocked ('US mobile carriers need business texting approval (10DLC) for this number first'), the Send button is disabled, and there is no link or CTA explaining how to get 10DLC approval. It's a dead end. UK/DE need a sender name ('add your sender name in Settings first') with no direct link either. Canada / Brazil work.

There is no way to compose a new outbound text from a CloudIVR number. The number's SMS tab only has delivery settings (email/webhook). Texts can only be sent as replies to inbound texts or missed calls. An account with no inbound texts can't send an SMS at all, and preview can't simulate an inbound text (the tester had to seed one in Mongo).

issues: Two voice pickers are shown (the ScriptBox 'Make AI voice' voice/speed and a separate 'Read out with' voice). It's unclear which one is used.

Picking today defaults the time to 09:00, which is often already past. The error 'Schedule between 5 minutes and 24 hours from now' only appears on submit. Default to now + 10 min, or validate inline.

design_issues.screen: Quick IVR / Campaign 'Route each key' menu
issues: The 'Play a message' action is text-only, with no audio library picker. The number IVR tab and the rest of the app offer audio for the same action. Text Triggers 'Text-to-Call message' is also text-only.

design_issues.screen: Number IVR tab key 'Play a message'
issues: Both text and audio can be set at once, with no hint about which one plays.
The cancel confirm says 'Keep it running' for a campaign that never started.
The list row shows '0 messages left' for a voicemail-drop campaign that never ran.

action_items: HIGH: Add a dry-run campaign simulator. In preview, POST /campaigns/:id/start (and the scheduled launcher) should never dial. Instead it should move the campaign created/scheduled -> running -> completed, give each lead a fake outcome (answered / keyPressed / noAnswer / voicemail + voicemailLeft) over a few seconds, and on completion create the repeat next run, so Live, the detail page, the CSV and 'Next run' can all be tested.

HIGH: Allow scheduledFor in dry-run (remove calls.js:66 or limit it to live mode) and run a dry-run-only scheduled launcher in preview that calls the simulator above, not bulkCallService.startCampaign. Keep the prod launcher guard so preview never places real calls.
MEDIUM: Fix the Add audio (and CallerIdPick) dialog layout: add !min-h-0 on DialogContent, because .civr sets min-height:100vh.
MEDIUM: CampaignNew: show the preview restriction on the Schedule field up front, or validate before scriptAudio() runs, so a rejected save doesn't leave an orphan TTS audio.

MEDIUM: SMS: add a CTA/link to 10DLC registration / the sender-name settings in the DestNote. Consider a 'New text' composer on the number SMS tab or the Inbox, and a preview-only 'simulate inbound text' so SMS can be tested.

LOW: Default the picked time to now + 10 min when today is chosen. Merge the duplicate voice pickers in Quick IVR. Offer an audio picker for menu 'Play a message'. Fix the 'Keep it running' copy for never-started campaigns.
critical_code_review_comments: calls.js runPlan(): the dry-run schedule block sits AFTER the 1-min..30-day validation. In preview the server message says '1 minute to 30 days' while the Quick IVR UI hint says '5 minutes to 24 hours'. The two windows are different and confusing.

Campaigns.js create(): scriptAudio() (paid TTS) runs before any server-side validation of leads/schedule/menu. Any 400 afterwards leaves a stray audio. Validate first, for example by calling /campaigns/estimate or a dry validation endpoint.
outbound.js GET /calls/scheduled mutates data on a GET (preview -> completed).
Quick-call scheduled preview calls never create a history entry, so 'appears in history' can't be verified for scheduled preview calls.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the 10 regression tests pass (2 of them pass only because they assert the current dry-run limits)
success_rate.frontend: ~75% (quick IVR, IVR tab, triggers, inbox reply, cancel OK; scheduled/repeat campaign and campaign run not testable in preview; dialog layout bug)
